plugins.name: agent-progress
plugins.description: A progress bar above the prompt for the subagents Claude starts, and an Agents pane with each one's model, step progress, context, estimated cost and time.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A one-line band above the prompt: context used and a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold. Fork of Ray Amjad's cache-clock that also restarts on cache-warmer's pings; handoff off by default.

plugins.name: cache-warmer
plugins.description: Keeps a big session's prompt cache warm while you are away: one cheap request over the cached transcript a few minutes before expiry, capped by hours and context size, with the cost shown.

plugins.name: launch-codes
plugins.description: Risky Bash and PowerShell commands and .env edits need launch codes: a red alert pane, a 4-character code to arm, and a LAUNCH to fire.

plugins.name: usage-credits
plugins.description: The plan's 5-hour and weekly use and your usage credits (the pool Fable draws on) on the status line under the prompt, refreshed from the session and your account.

plugins.name: usage-quota
plugins.description: A compact context band above the prompt: context use with its breakdown, one-click Compact and per-session Auto compact. Fork of Anant Raghunath's usage-quota without the 5-hour and weekly meters (usage-credits shows those) and without polling.

plugins.name: mod-template
plugins.description: Starter mod: copy this folder to begin a new mod.
